hypotheses.source_transfer: Weight-derived head-conditional source32 charts reach >=0.80 held-out-head response fidelity and improve by >=0.10 over global natural64.
hypotheses.family_transfer: Source32 conditional charts improve by >=0.10 over natural64 on half and paired removals.
hypotheses.conditional_advantage: Source32 conditional charts exceed shared perturbation-source32 fidelity by >=0.10 on held-out heads.
hypotheses.natural_retention: Mean natural coefficient R2 of the source32 single-head charts is within 0.05 of natural64.
hypotheses.larger_budget: Source64 conditional charts reach >=0.80 held-out-head fidelity and beat equal-budget natural128 by >=0.10.

scope: Source projector P yields Qhat=PQ+QP-PQP, preserving every interaction touching P. Rank r needs at most 2r quadratic reads plus one exact linear read. Shared P comes from even-head discovery perturbations; conditional P comes only from declared head c_proj weight columns, with no held-out-head data fit. Conditional charts are source-indexed response explanations, not one common forward scalar function.
